title: Fake Sand
description: Mod for spawning floating glowing fake sand client side
body:
**This mod spawns sand**

![Floating Glowing Sand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/y8b9eceK/images/0008867e2dac4f40cece148e3103386c5736f4cd_350.webp)

there are keybinds
- B - spawn block
- G - toggle gravity
- O - toggle outlines
